senses.gloss:
Is considered as a synonym of बीजपूर, but acc. to Gul it is CITRUS
DECUMANA MURR.; acc. to KB 1, p. 488-489 it may also designate
[CITRUS MEDICA LINN. VAR. LIMONUM].

mātuluṅgī
Śivadāsa on Cakradatta, agnimāndya 40 and vātavyādhi 40: = madhukuk-
kuṭī, probably identical with madhukarkaṭī.
